messages.subject: which item selected
parts:
Hi,
I just wanted to know that in the following code, how to find the pattern of the items that selected for a specific person?
results <- mirtCAT(
  mo = mod,
  local_pattern = response_patterns,
  design_elements=FALSE,
  design = design,
  preCAT = preCAT_block,  # Include the preCAT block
  method = 'MAP',  # Maximum a posteriori estimation
  criteria = 'MI',  # Maximum information criteria
  progress = TRUE,
  content_prop = rep(0.2, content_areas)
  )

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: which item selected
parts:
Use summary(results[[index_number]]) to pull out the summary information for a specific element. When the input local_pattern has more than one row a list of mirtCAT() objects is returned instead.

Phil
